title: Glass for the windows
Panes for the {place}
summary: The windows of the {place} in {settlement} are boarded for want of glass. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver}.
offer: The {place} is built but dark as a cellar: no glass. {count} × {item} would let the light in.
Our glassblower moved away last spring. Could you bring {count} × {item}?
progress: Glass, please, before the folk forget what sun looks like.
complete: Light at last! The {place} looks twice the size.
